# Ovaar

> Software engineering blog by Thomas Reynders, a software engineer in Leeuwarden (NL) who leads 3D product configurator work at Elfsquad. Posts are first-hand notes on C++ and Conan, Python tooling, CI pipelines, embedded Linux, 3D on the web and working with coding agents.

All content is licensed CC BY-NC 4.0. Full post text is also available in the RSS feed: https://ovaar.github.io/index.xml

## About

- [About Thomas Reynders](https://ovaar.github.io/about/): background, current work and links
